name: richard-qu-portfolio
description: Dependency-free static portfolio for GitHub Pages

scripts.lint: node --check site/app.js && node --check site/theme.js && python scripts/build_site.py --check && python scripts/check_site.py
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.cjs && python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py
scripts.start: npm run build && python -m http.server 4173 --bind 127.0.0.1 --directory site
